hook: Kothagudem coal mine idle *5 days* over contract workers' bonus strike
hook_b: Kothagudem coal mine idle *5 days* over contract workers' bonus strike
tldr: Production at SCCL's VKCM opencast mine in Kothagudem has been halted for five days by a contract workers' strike.

beats.what: Workers of Shodha Constructions, which handles overburden removal and coal extraction at VKCM, want a 20% annual bonus.
beats.why: SCCL's CMD told contractors to meet overburden-removal targets and deploy enough machines and staff.
beats.care: SCCL coal feeds TG GENCO thermal plants that power Telangana, including Hyderabad.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: SCCL has set a daily overburden target of 1.415 million cubic metres; the Kothagudem region's share is 0.55 million.

cards.q: How should the bonus dispute be settled?

qs: Has the strike affected coal stocks at GENCO plants yet?

facts.t: SCCL's daily overburden target across all areas is *1.415 million cubic metres*.

viz.l: Kothagudem region's share of SCCL's daily OB target
viz.verdict: Kothagudem carries about 39% of the daily target

viz.l: coal a day owed to GENCO

learn.t: Overburden (OB) = soil and rock removed to reach coal in an opencast mine

watch: Whether Shodha Constructions and the workers' JAC reach a deal.
